channel.title: Area Development Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Area Development Magazine (areadevelopment.com)

item.title: The Cold Chain Sector Recalibration
item.description: A surge of new supply, aging legacy facilities, and shifting operator strategies are creating a widening divide between modern, efficient assets and obsolete space across the nation’s cold storage footprint.

item.title: Leading Metro Locations 2025: Smaller Markets, Stronger Momentum
item.description: Smaller and mid-sized U.S. metros are outpacing big cities, leveraging workforce agility, affordability, and livability to redefine competitiveness and attract investment in 2025.

item.title: A Single Front Door for Corporate Investment in Fort Worth
item.description: Manufacturers and corporate real estate executives often talk about speed to market and clarity of process as deciding factors in site selection. Fort Worth is testing what happens when a city reorganizes itself around those principles.

item.title: Manhattan’s Old Ramps, New Logistics
item.description: In an undersupplied NYC market, a historic multistory facility shows why what seemed obsolete is now indispensable for last-mile distribution.

item.title: Amazon’s First Mass Timber Delivery Station Tests the Future of Low-Carbon Logistics
item.description: In Elkhart, Indiana, a 171,000-square-foot “wood warehouse” built by Graycor may point the way toward a more sustainable model for industrial construction.

item.title: The New Industrial Revolution in Biotech
item.description: Domestic drug production is becoming a matter of national security, not just market strategy.

item.title: Peek a Boo Data Centers
item.description: AI’s power hunger is pushing data centers underground, underwater—and soon into orbit—redefining cooling, reliability, and sustainable energy.

item.title: Editor's Note: The Year Site Selection Grew Up
item.description: Energy availability takes center stage as companies compete for grid capacity and rethink growth strategies

item.title: Why Industrial Developers Are Turning to On-Site Energy
item.description: Facilities facing interconnection bottlenecks are accelerating production by investing directly in resilient, on-site energy systems.

item.title: Data Centers in 2025: When Power Became the Gatekeeper
item.description: The era of easy expansion is over—success now depends on early alignment among utilities, governments, and capital.
